records.text: Petitioners sought review in the Sixth Circuit, which denied relief.
It thus ordered petitioners to follow the mandatory terms of the 2011 CBA, bargain in good faith going forward, and reinstate Union dues withholding.
Petitioners contend that federalism concerns require us to read the Statute to exempt them from the FLRA's jurisdiction.

Because no petitioner is an “agency” within the meaning of § 7105(g)(3), I would reverse the judgment of the Sixth Circuit and hold that petitioners fall outside the remedial jurisdiction of the FLRA.
